name: After recital BZ
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: BZa. whereas for years the EU has implemented agreements such as the Political Dialogue and Cooperation Agreement (PDCA), opening the way to political and economic cooperation with the communist regime in Cuba; whereas, in return, the Cuban regime has failed to fulfil any of its commitments and has instead further intensified its violations of fundamental freedoms, including freedom of expression, assembly, religion and association, as well as fundamental rights, including labour rights; whereas Havana is additionally a close partner of the regimes in Moscow and Minsk, providing them with political support and contributing negatively to European security, inter alia, by facilitating the involvement of hundreds of Cuban mercenaries in Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine; whereas, despite these facts, repeated calls from the Cuban democratic opposition, testimonies of former political prisoners, appeals by human rights defenders and repeated calls by Parliament, the EU has to date failed to activate the suspension clause of the PDCA; whereas this continued inaction is exploited by the communist regime as a form of political support and shamefully places the EU on the side of the regime rather than that of the Cuban people and their fundamental right to dignity, freedom and democracy;
